name: Smooth Brightness
description: Automatic screen brightness without the jumps, and the brightness slider moves with it. Filters sensor noise, does one smooth 5-second fade per change (turning around mid-fade if the light changes), uses a fixed curve from 1% in darkness to 100% in bright light, and remembers how far above or below auto you drag the slider. On/off with GNOME's Automatic Screen Brightness switch.
